sources.terms: NCBI GEO public repository terms and source attribution
sources.citation: van Beers et al. Associations of inflammation, iron and early death in sickle cell disease. Blood (2015). GEO GSE53441
sources.assay: Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 microarray
sources.source_preprocessing: GEO series matrix with background correction, quantile normalization, and median-polish summarization reported by submitters
limitations: GEO summary reports 24 SCA and 9 healthy subjects, while the matrix contains 24 SCA and 10 control samples
Participant mapping for the extra control sample is unavailable
Bulk PBMC signal is systemic immune association, not endothelial identity
